findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT- The triple sink is observed to not be fully sealed to the wall and the caulking is in a state of disrepair. Ensure that the triple sink is fully sealed to the wall and that the sealing is made to be smooth and easily cleanable. Physical facilities should be maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The walk-in cooler fan covers are observed to have an accumulation of dust on them. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that physical facilities are cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
The following food-contact surfaces were observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The soda gun holder, as well as the soda gun nozzle in the bar area were observed soiled with dried liquids. The person-in-charge mentioned that the gun holder was recently replaced. Both the nozzle and the holder were sanitized during the visit to correct the violation. 
2. A cutting board was observed to be stored behind the faucet of the triple sink. CORRECTED- The cutting board was pulled to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Ensure that cutting boards are stored in an area away from contamination. 
3. There were knives stored between the preparation cooler and the wall, where the knives were in contact with the wall. The wall and side of the preparation cooler are not food-contact surfaces. CORRECTED- The knives were pulled to be cleaned. Ensure that knives are being stored in a manner that does not expose them to contamination. 

Ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent accumulated debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment:
The following food items were observed to be kept past their 7-day date-marking:

1. Two containers of cooked and cooled wings with a date of 2/18.
2. A container of sautéed peppers and onions with a date of 2/18.
3. A container of potato skins with a date of 2/18.
4. A container of cooked chicken with a date of 2/18.

CORRECTED- All of these food items were discarded. Ensure that Time/Temperature control foods are discarded by the end of the 7th day.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a plastic cup being used to scoop sugar from the bulk container. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that all RTE foods are not touched by bare hands. In this case, the facility must use a scoop with a handle to scoop the sugar to ensure no contact between human hands and RTE foods. CORRECTED PIC replaced the cup with a scoop with a handle.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed there to be a build-up of food debris behind the shelves in the walk-in cooler. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that cooler is cleaned regularly enough to prevent the build-up of food debris in hard-to-reach areas.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed a few items in the facility to not bear date marks. Items include:

-Sliced cheese in a prep drawer in the kitchen.
-Half and Half in the bar display cooler.
-Juice in the bar reach-in cooler.

Discussed with PIC and PIC had them dated immediately. Ensure that temperature and time controlled food items are date marked within 24 hours of opening
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. (A) Except when PACKAGING FOOD using a REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING method as specified under § 3-502.12, and except as specified in (E) and (F) of this section, refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 5C (41F) or less for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 Inspector observed a white air conditioning unit in front of the hand sink in the kitchen. The air conditioning unit was removed as the kitchen is too small and the unit blocks access to the hand sink. The violation is considered corrected on site. Maintain area in front of the hand sink free of blockages.

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: Inspector observed the soda gun at the bar to be soiled. The soda dispensing gun requires regular cleaning with the process of wash, rinse, sanitize. (not just soaking)  The violation is considered corrected on site. The soda gun was properly cleaned at time of inspection and before the facility opened. Maintain these items clean.

(A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Proper cooling time and temperature
findings.comment:
3-501.14: Pan of chili in the walk in cooler is 48F when temperature checked with a probe thermometer. The chili was placed into the walk in last night and did not cool properly. The batch of chili that it was taken from on 6/24/24 has an internal temperature of 44F. Both pans of chili were discarded out of an abundance of caution. It is evident from their temperature that they did not hit safe cooling temperature bench marks, Cooling processes were discussed with the PIC and cook during the inspection. Inspector encouraged active cooling methods be added to the practice of putting the chili in the walk in cooler. The violation is considered corrected on site. 


(A) TCS FOOD shall be cooled within in 2 hours from 135F to 70F. Within 6 hours, FOOD shall cool from 135F to 41F or less. (B) TCS FOOD shall be cooled within 4 hours or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient temperature. (C) TCS FOOD received above 45F in compliance with LAWS shall be cooled within 4 hours. (D) Raw EGGS shall be received and immediately placed in EQUIPMENT with air temperature of 45F or less.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: Inspector observed several TCS foods prepared on site that require date marking to be in containers void of dates. 
Items included but may not be limited to: Chili, Au jus, and cheese sauce. Items were properly date marked. Ensure that a good habit of properly date marking foods is developed in the facility. 


(A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: Inspector observed the drip tray of the pizza oven and the catch tray under to stove top to be overly soiled with food debris. Ensure that these trays are cleaned on a more regular basis. 

(B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.comment:

Area under shelf to the left of the make table has food splash. Clean and maintain the shelves clean.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625/3.07 Sec. 3.07. Allergen awareness training. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter.

Ensure that all certified food protection managers have taken the allergen awareness training within 30 days of employment. Keep copies of certificates in the binder.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

Upon arrival, the bar hand sink was blocked by a stool holding containers with bar pours in them. The containers and stool was removed from in front of the hand sink. Take care to never block access to hand sinks. The violation was corrected on site.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

Sanitizer in the kitchen wiping cloth bucket tested at 0ppm of quat sanitizer. The bucket was emptied and filled with the sanitizer dispenser at the 3 part sink. The bucket now tests at 200 ppm quat sanitizer. Take care to maintain the sanitizer buckets used in the facility at proper concentrations.The violation was corrected on site.

findings.comment:

Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).
